# 4DMap

Inspection coordinate frame (4DM-WP-1.0) version 0.3.0.
Author: Aziel Eliab. Softwares bucket: Plain. Apache-2.0. Growth-ON.

THIS IS: a four-axis inspection frame T/Δ/Γ/Π after AZPIPE.
4DM-CARD receipts. Fail-closed SHA-256. Forks kept. ZionPattern cap 75%.
Π-EMPTY when the lens is silent. Companion softwares
(TemporalLock, StaticClock, ChronoLock, TrajectoryLock, SpectralLock)
are inspection inputs only — cite, do not merge.
Aziel Digital Library is a Research-domain neighbor (cite/pin-frame).
Library pins: paper date × event × lat/lon or gazetteer. Never upload time.
Possibility and Bayesian stay labeled separately. Not courtroom proof.
Adaptive pattern memory is the hashchain lattice (tips, prev-hash, pin
receipts) — not a detached ML store. NO-REWRITE. REAL vs MOCK labeled.

THIS IS NOT: a truth engine; Lumen; GIS 4D; a Node Gate; certified
forensics; an identity store; a Softwares door.
domains_are_doors: false. FragGate is THE single door.
Suite mesh default OFF. GET /v1/mesh never enables.

AKM-TRIAD-1.0 is LIVE fabric (not a Softwares-tab product). Optional
4DMap card cite/observe only. Posterior ≠ truth. No history rewrite.
Agent memory writes: FragGate memory_* / POST /v1/memory/*.
